ruleset.name: Spring Rules Test
ruleset.description: 3 条 Spring XPath 规则最终验证

rule.name: TransactionalOnNonProxyableMethod
rule.message: @Transactional 标在 private/static/final 方法上，CGLIB/JDK 代理无法覆盖，事务不生效。改为 public 非 final 非 static 方法

rule.name: TransactionalMissingRollbackFor
rule.message: @Transactional 未指定 rollbackFor，受检异常（IOException/SQLException）默认提交不回滚。须显式 @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AvoidDeprecatedListenableFuture
rule.message: ListenableFuture 在 Spring 6 / SpringBoot 3.x 已 @Deprecated，改用 CompletableFuture

property.name: xpath
